repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c98f1ce6255f5585fc851b9de038f7316ea796dc`
Local-runs: probe — the brief asked for the pins and ablations to be re-run, so a throwaway worktree at the head ran the inbox pin file, three ablations, the four i18n pins, `check-adr-0087-registration` and one stale-toast probe; worktree removed
Scope: .changeset/36855-bulk-approve-failure-reasons.md, ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.inlineActionsVisible-34587.test.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts + ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalsApi.ts, ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts, packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ConsoleToaster.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/ui/alert-dialog.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, the four `approvalsInbox.${key}` wrapper files in app-shell, tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` (read in the cited code, outside the diff)

Face: narrowing (`record-recognisers --template --paths` refused the fifteen paths as deciding no face and pointed at the changeset's `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` line; `--face narrowing` maps to this tier).

### ① Derived judgments

- The retired key has no reader at head. `git grep bulkPartial` over the whole tree at the head (not only `ui packages apps examples skills`) finds the word only in this PR's changeset, apart from `bulkPartialSummary`. No test key list, docs page or skill names it.
- Dynamic construction: `approvalsInbox.${key}` is built in five wrappers across four files (the console page's `tr`, `RecordApprovalsPanel`, two in `ApprovalDecisionPanel`, `ApprovalActionTimeline`). Every call of them passes a string literal; the one multi-line call (`needsDecisionInputs`) is literal too. No `bulk${…}` or `${…}Partial` composition, no `keyPrefix`, no whole-namespace read (`t('approvalsInbox')`, `returnObjects`). The test-side constructions iterate their own lists, which do not hold the key.
- The key was released. Tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` (package version 18.6.0) carries `approvalsInbox.bulkPartial` in all eleven packs, and so does the npm tarball `i18n-18.6.0.tgz` (`dist/locales/*.js`, eleven files).
- The removal is exactly one key. #37230's `released-keys-removed.mjs`, run against the tag, reports 67 keys absent on `origin/main` and 68 at this head; the one added entry is `approvalsInbox.bulkPartial` with the eleven locales the changeset lists.
- The six new keys (`bulkPartialSummary`, `bulkFailureLine`, `bulkFailuresShowAll`, `bulkFailuresTitle`, `bulkFailuresBody`, `close`) are in all eleven packs with their holes intact. zh-Hant matches the generator (pin green).
- Pins at head: the inbox pin file gives 9 passed; the four i18n pins give 66 passed.
- Ablations reproduce. `reason: ''` (blob `d21c8808ce8e` to `8724dfc2388a`, the dev's pair) turns two pins red with `expected 'Bulk Invoice 2: ' to be 'Bulk Invoice 2: …'`. The dialog list cut to the first three turns the third pin red (`length of 5 but got 3`). Dropping ko's `bulkFailuresBody` and the allowlist line turns key parity and the identity pin red. Files restored to `d21c8808ce8e`.
- Check-runs on the head: 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed, including Check Changeset, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Test UI 1 to 16, Dogfood Regression Gate and Governed Surface Queue Guard.
- K = 7 against `origin/main` `4ed453dc211`; merge base `057cedfa9b6`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` is clean (tree `edf5c3c5a52`). Main's seven commits touch no locale pack and no file under the console's `pages/system`.
- Locale overlap: #37166, #37226 and #37210 each touch the same eleven pack files, in other namespaces. A pairwise `git merge-tree` of this head with each of them, and with #37169, is clean.
- `b6468047c5..c98f1ce625` is one added changeset line (`Skills-docs:`), so the dogfood reading at `b6468047c5` stands for the code; CI's Dogfood Regression Gate also passed at this head.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` is right. `Metadata-protocol: none` is true: `TranslationDataSchema` is a strict object, its `messages` ids are single-segment, and no metadata key can spell `approvalsInbox.bulkPartial`; only a host's own i18next resources can override it. A `none` change takes `patch`, breaking or not, with the BREAKING line and the ADR-0087 disposition kept. #37169 uses the same level; the one `major` rides #37230.
- The declaration follows rulings 7153171432 and 7153326968 (both on #36890): `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, and the key listed under 「Removed translation keys」 with its locales. The heading, the namespace sentence, the list line and the BREAKING line follow #37169's changeset form.
- `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is the right category. It is in the gate's list; `Metadata-protocol` is not `narrowed`, so the outright refusal does not apply; the positive categories do not fit (the packs are still exported, so `runtime-export-retired` fails its first predicate, and runtime strings changed, so it is not type-only). #37169 and #37230 both use it for retired translation keys. The gate passes at head with this one declared-breaking changeset.
- "Retired in 19.0.0" rests on #37230, which is open and waits for the maintainer. Ruling 7153326968 already covers the order: no non-major release is cut before it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, the surface grew into `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts`: it is a locale-pack test, inside the claim's "their tests". Accepted.
- Dev flag, `humanizeError` falls through to the error's own text: answered under S2 and N3.
- Dev flag, `vitest run scripts/` not re-run after the changeset-only commits: CI's Test UI passed at this head.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no data path in the diff.
- No `open_questions` entry.

### ④ Design judgment

- The narrowing takes away one string that nothing reads. A host override of it stops showing; nothing else changes for that host. That part holds.
- Reason safety: bulk uses the same `humanizeError(err, tr('actionFailed', …))` call as the single-row Approve and Reject, so the two cannot differ. A marked `userMessage` is shown as written; 403, 404 and 409 get the page's fixed lines. The fall-through is not generic, see S2 and N3.
- Dialog: Radix `AlertDialog`, so focus is trapped, lands on Close, and Escape closes. It is rendered outside the bulk bar and outside any tab condition. `escapeValue: false`, so titles and reasons are not double-escaped; React escapes them.
- S1 (should-fix) — The sticky toast's "Show all" opens whatever the latest run left, not the run the toast reports. `onClick` only calls `setBulkFailuresOpen(true)`, and every `runBulk` overwrites `bulkFailures` (with `[]` on a clean run). Probe, run at head: a run with 5 failures, then a clean run of 2 with the first toast still up, then the first toast's "Show all (5)". The dialog reads "Not decided: 0" with an empty list (`PROBE items=0 title=Not decided: 0`). After a second partial failure it lists the wrong rows. The toaster is app-wide and the toast has `duration: Infinity`, so it also outlives the page; there the action does nothing. Fix direction: have the action carry its own run's list (`setBulkFailures(failures)` in `onClick`), and dismiss the toast by id when the next run starts and on unmount. Add a pin for two runs.
- S2 (should-fix) — The changeset says each reason is the `userMessage`, else the page's line, "else a generic "Action failed"". The code returns `err.message || fallback`, and `approvalsApi.call` always sets a message (`${code}: ${msg}`). So a 500 shows `APPROVAL_APPROVE_FAILED: ` plus up to 500 characters of the server's exception text (`approvals-routes.ts:632`), a dropped connection shows `Failed to fetch`, and "Action failed" is in practice never reached. The PR body's "What changes" and Acceptance notes say this correctly; the changeset, which ships, does not. Fix: name the error's own text in that sentence.
- N1 — The ADR-0087 marker says a host "has nothing to rewrite", while the last line tells it to "move its wording to `approvalsInbox.bulkPartialSummary`". The category stands; #37230's wording ("nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite") is the exact one.
- N2 — With one to three failures the toast keeps the 4-second default and has no action. Three rows with reasons cannot be read in that time, and the reasons cannot be reopened, though the state holds them.
- N3 — `humanizeError`'s unrecognised branch shows raw `CODE: text`, and its 429 and 501 lines speak of reminders and recall. This is the single-row behaviour today and outside the card; a bulk run now repeats it per row. It deserves its own card.
- N4 — The pins drive bulk Approve only. Bulk Reject shares `runBulk` and is not pinned; the unrecognised-error branch is not pinned either.
- N5 — The dialog opens from a toast button that sonner removes on click, so on close focus returns to the page body. The list scroller has no `tabindex`, so keyboard scrolling depends on the browser.
- N6 — The PR body counts four wrappers; there are five definitions in four files. The zero holds.

Two findings are open, S1 and S2. Each needs a head change and a delta review; this record does not clear the head.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36855-bulk-approve-reasons`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- Check-runs on the head: 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed. K = 7 against main `4ed453dc211`; `git merge-tree` is clean. Pairwise merges with #37166, #37226, #37210 and #37169 are clean; they touch other namespaces of the same packs.
- N1 — The ADR-0087 marker says a host "has nothing to rewrite", while the last changeset line tells it to move its wording to `bulkPartialSummary`. Use #37230's wording.
- N2 — One to three failures show for the 4-second default with no action; the reasons cannot be reopened.
- N3 — `humanizeError`'s raw fall-through and its reminder / recall lines for 429 and 501 are single-row behaviour today. The seat asks triage for a card; it is outside #36855.
- N4 — Bulk Reject and the unrecognised-error branch are not pinned.
- N5 — On close, focus returns to the page body; the dialog's list scroller has no `tabindex`.
- N6 — The PR body counts four wrappers; there are five definitions in four files.
- "Retired in 19.0.0" rests on #37230, still open with the maintainer; ruling 7153326968 covers the order.
- Contract review at the same head is in the `## Contract review` record: S1 and S2 open, so it does not clear this head. No hand-off to the maintainer this round.
- Next: the dev fixes S1 and S2 on the same branch; the seat then does a delta review and a new L1, and hands the narrowing to the maintainer.

- Delta L1 on card #36855 after the REWORK at `c98f1ce6255f5585fc851b9de038f7316ea796dc`. The delta is two commits and three files (+79/-28): the changeset, the page and its pin file. The eleven locale packs and the allowlist line did not move. The PR is 15 files, +349/-21, draft, `Fixes #36855`.
- S1: closed. The toast's "Show all" now carries its own run's list: `setBulkFailures(failures)` runs inside `onClick`, and no run writes the dialog's list any more. `failures` is a per-run local, so nothing a later run does can reach it. The new pin is the repro: 5 failures, a clean run, then the first toast's "Show all (5)" lists rows 1 to 5 under "Not decided: 5".
- Ablation re-run by the seat: the capture removed and the run-end write put back (blob `a729e1db98b7` to `c783de858825`, the dev's pair). The pin file gives 1 failed / 9 passed, and the dialog reads "Not decided: 0". Restored to `a729e1db98b7`.
- Unmount: the page keeps the ids of the toasts it raised and dismisses them when it unmounts. Probe at head: the raised toast's id is dismissed on unmount. The id set cannot grow past one entry per partial-failure run, and dismissing an id that is already gone does nothing in sonner 2.0.8.
- The dev did not take "dismiss on the next run". That is sound: with each action holding its own list, an older toast stays correct, and the pin needs it on screen.
- S2: closed. Changeset sentences read against the code: "else the error's own text as the console's approvals client reports it (`CODE: message` ...)" and "The generic "Action failed" shows only for an error that carries no text at all" match `humanizeError` and `approvalsApi.call`. "It stays until dismissed" and "every failed row of that run ... even after a later bulk run" match the page. The PR body says the same.
- Prior N2, taken and pinned: every partial-failure toast now has `duration: Infinity` and a close button, whatever the count. The one-row pin asserts `duration` is `Infinity` with no action; the five-row pin asserts the same with the action. The changeset states it. Prior N6 is taken in the PR body.
- Narrowing declaration, unchanged and still right. The PR body and the changeset both read `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` through `readClause2Line`. The BREAKING line, the "Removed translation keys" list and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` are byte-identical to the prior head.
- Removed keys, measured again. The PR's locale diff removes one line per pack, `bulkPartial`, in all eleven packs. `released-keys-removed.mjs` (now on main) against tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`: main 76, this head merged with main 77; the one added entry is `approvalsInbox.bulkPartial` with the eleven locales the changeset lists.
- #37230 merged, so main is in Changesets pre mode and the 19.0.0 line is open. The prior caveat on "retired in 19.0.0" is closed.
- Pins at head: 10 passed (inbox file), 66 passed (four i18n pins). On the merge with current main the same five files give 76 passed, and `check-adr-0087-registration` exits 0.
- Check-runs on the head: 47 success, 15 skipped (all expected), 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face` reads every mechanical item ok; its one flag is the dogfood item, answered next.
- Dogfood: the trusted os-dev report 7164781165 on the card pins `dogfood_battery` to `bc989143b4`: command exit 0, Test Files 487 passed and 3 skipped of 490, Tests 4128 passed and 68 skipped, no failures. CI's Dogfood Regression Gate is also green at this head.
- K = 19 against main `1a628673d26`; merge base `057cedfa9b6`; `git merge-tree` is clean (tree `ef24c4d7caa`). Main now touches the eleven packs too (#37210, #37226), in other namespaces.
- 维护者速读 in the PR body: its three statements hold at this head. It does not say the toast now stays until closed; the seat's hand-off brief adds that. Its fourth line reads 「无」; the hand-off brief asks for the approval.
- N1 closed by the seat — the card's claim 7159898636 read `Clause-②: no` while the PR body and changeset read `yes (narrowing)`. The seat edited that claim in place through the relay. Only its `Clause-②:` line changed, read-back identical, and `readClause2Line` now returns `declared / yes / narrowing`.
- N2 — A bulk run that ends after the page is left still raises its toast. Probe at head: unmount during the run, then the run ends with 6 failures. The toast is raised sticky with "Show all (6)", nothing dismisses it, and the action opens nothing. The changeset's "dismissed when the Approval Center is left" holds only for toasts already on screen. A follow-up card should skip the action when the page is gone.
- N3 — The unmount dismissal has no pin. The seat's probe passes; a later edit could drop the effect unseen.
- N4 — The PR body's "Dogfood battery" block and the opening line of "Verification" still name the older heads `c98f1ce625` and `935499b5e`. The "Round 3" block has the readings for this head.
- Not taken, still nits from the prior L1: its N1 (the ADR-0087 marker's "nothing to rewrite" wording), N3 (the raw fall-through of `humanizeError`; the seat owes triage a card), N4 (bulk Reject not pinned) and N5 (focus after the dialog closes).

No must-fix, no should-fix.
